subject: Re: KiteCorp — Attendee headcount increase & late travel approval
messages:

Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: KiteCorp: request to increase onsite attendee count + late travel booking

Hi Grace / Marissa,

Quick note — our internal headcount has shifted and we now need to bring 6 attendees to the San Jose workshop (previously 3). This change happened after the initial SOW was issued. The workshop is scheduled for 2026-09-10-11 at Redwood HQ.

Ask: can Redwood approve an attendee headcount override (+3 seats) and a late travel booking exception for flights arriving the morning of 9/10 (we understand this breaches the 48-hour policy)?

Budget: we can cover per-person travel within the original allocation but will need Redwood to approve the additional seats and one-night hotel for two attendees due to late travel. I attached the updated attendee list and a quick cost estimate (kitecorp_headcount_request.xlsx).

We can move any cost to the marketplace invoice if that makes approvals simpler. Please advise next steps and whether finance sign-off is required.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Events — KiteCorp
elena.ruiz@kitecorp.com
+1 415-555-0198

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and for the spreadsheet.

Short answer: we can usually approve additional attendee seats for paid workshops, but the late-travel exception (arriving morning of 9/10) requires a one-time waiver from Finance for the hotel-night and a headcount confirmation to ensure catering and seating.

Can you confirm:
- Names and titles for the 3 additional attendees (final list)
- Which two attendees need the extra hotel night and approximate flight arrival times
- Whether KiteCorp will absorb any overages or wants Redwood to bill the incremental cost

I will loop in Marissa to confirm the commercial side; if Finance needs to sign off we will get the request in their queue today.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Elena / Grace —

We appreciate the update. From a commercial standpoint I'm comfortable approving the +3 seats for the paid workshop (we'll bill KiteCorp for the additional headcount).

Regarding the late travel and extra hotel nights: Finance needs to approve any hotel-night exception. Vivek — can we authorize up to $2,400 in incremental travel/hotel for this engagement (covers 2 nights for 2 attendees + last-minute fare buffer)? If approved, Ben can coordinate bookings via our travel desk.

Next steps:
- Elena: please confirm final attendee names in the Drive doc.
- Ben: hold 3 additional seats on the workshop roster and stand by for PO/charge code.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Marissa / Grace —

Approved: finance will sign off on up to $2,400 incremental spend for this engagement. Conditions:
- KiteCorp to confirm attendee names in the shared Drive link and sign the amended headcount addendum before travel is booked.
- Any incremental spend above $2,400 requires explicit re-approval.
- Booking must use corporate travel desk and be tagged to REQ-9876 in our finance system.

I've attached the signed approval form for records (approved_headcount_form.pdf). Ben, please proceed to book the extra seats and the two hotel nights for the specified attendees once KiteCorp uploads the final list.

Regards,
